skills: Document of Sun Moon and Star

atk: +1 ATK. About 30 ATK is worth 1% damage at endgame, so 0.3.
p_all: bAddClass Class_All, bAddRace RC_All, bAddSize Size_All, bAddEle Ele_All. Reference unit.
p_bn: bAddClass Class_Boss / Class_Normal: half the targets but the ones that matter.
rangerate: bShortAtkRate or bLongAtkRate. Its own multiplier in renewal, so strong.
atkrate: Weak in renewal (only boosts part of ATK), as the owner noted.
ignoredef: vs all targets; Boss/Normal counts half, one race 10%.
atkele: Endows the weapon with an element.
matkrate: bMatkRate. Applies to all MATK in renewal, much stronger than bAtkRate.
m_all: bMagicAddClass Class_All, bMagicAddRace RC_All, bMagicAtkEle Ele_All...
m_atkele: bMagicAtkEle on one element. Casters often stick to one element.
skillatk4: bSkillAtk on a 4th-job skill this job owns. Per skill, % above 100 has diminishing returns (log curve): +100% counts as 69, +500% as 179, +2500% as 326.
skillatk3: Same curve. 3rd-job skills are weaker than 4th-job skills in endgame.
skillatk2: Same curve. Old skills like Cold Bolt or Storm Gust.
skillcd: Only for skills the job has; at most 3 s counted per skill. -1 s = 8 CP.
sub_all: bSubRace RC_All, bSubClass Class_All, bSubEle Ele_All...
flag_util: No knockback, no gemstone, no walk delay, armor element...
slot: Per slot. A good card is worth several % damage, so 40.
